name: Kamov Ka-52 Alligator
protection: Armoured side-by-side cockpit, ejection seats. Game: cockpit/engine armour stops small-calibre; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm can damage rotors, engines and tail boom; MANPADS/launchers kill.
visual_notes: Coaxial contra-rotating rotors (two stacked 3-blade rotors), no tail rotor - instantly recognisable
Side-by-side two-seat cockpit, wide bulbous nose with ball-turret optics (GOES-451) under the chin
Twin vertical tail fins on a short tail boom; stub wings with 4 pylons and wingtip countermeasure pods
Cannon mounted on the right fuselage side
